explanation: Male satin bowerbirds favour blue decorations, from feathers and berries to bottle tops and clothes pegs, and some even paint the bower's walls with chewed plant matter.

claims.text: Male bowerbirds build structures of sticks, called bowers, and decorate them with collected objects to attract females.
Weaverbirds, magpies and hornbills do not build decorated courtship bowers.
Male satin bowerbirds favour blue decorations, including man-made objects such as bottle tops and clothes pegs.
Some bowerbirds paint the walls of their bowers with chewed plant material.
